exact_prompt: Transparent targeted forest correction atlas exactly 6 columns x 3 rows, views FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Rows: (1) diagonal fallen forest log, (2) abandoned woodland hut, (3) forest shrine. Use source+current contact for identity and materials. Only flagged cells are used. Row1 log: retain a fixed grounded diagonal XY placement. FRONT, RIGHT, LEFT, REAR must be strict horizontal-camera orthographic elevations where the long log axis runs perfectly HORIZONTALLY in the image, not tilted diagonally toward a corner and not circular end-on. Show bark and attached small branches along full log length, with the lowest edge at a consistent ground height. TOP/BOTTOM placeholders may be identity-consistent. Row2 hut RIGHT and LEFT: camera looks perpendicular to long front-to-back roof ridge, so show long side wall under eaves and the roof slope running into depth, with side window and roof plane; no front/rear gable triangle, no front door, no three-quarter gable face. Row3 shrine TOP: directly overhead nadir of the low altar slab and candle-holder tops; the vertical round medallion/back-slab and tall candle bodies are occluded below the plane, show only its narrow upper edge if physically exposed, tabletop and small circular wick tops. No upright frontal altar composition. Keep forest colors, bark, wood, ivy, stone and candle materials. No perspective/isometric. Full objects centered, transparent background, no borders or labels.
